descriptions.w3d_s4_card_check_step: Dispatches card-file recovery checks and reports completion or a required prompt.
descriptions.w3d_s4_card_check_begin: Prepares original and temporary filenames for the card-file check.
descriptions.w3d_s4_card_check_open_old: Opens the original save file and records its number or absence.
descriptions.w3d_s4_card_check_open_temp: Opens the temporary save file and chooses recovery or free-space checks.
descriptions.w3d_s4_card_check_status: Checks whether the temporary save file has a valid data offset.
descriptions.w3d_s4_card_check_delete_old: Deletes the original save file before restoring the temporary file.
descriptions.w3d_s4_card_check_restore: Renames the temporary file and updates the original file number on success.
descriptions.w3d_s4_card_check_delete_temp: Deletes an invalid temporary save file when it exists.
descriptions.w3d_s4_card_check_space: Checks available card blocks and file slots for the requested save size.
descriptions.w3d_s4_card_check_delete_message: Handles confirmation to delete the temporary card file.
descriptions.w3d_s4_card_check_space_message: Handles the insufficient-space prompt for an existing save context.
descriptions.w3d_s4_card_check_initial_space_message: Handles the insufficient-space prompt during initial file checks.
